designDecisions: WIRING FIX IS SLICE 1 (Max folded it here, not a standalone light fix): the 'New planet' button (~L5188) and macro-seed GUI slider (~L5186) call updateSeedUniforms()+rebakeE5Bands() but never applyDrivers() — the storm/polar writer never re-runs on those reseed paths (verified live 2026-07-15: _lab.setSeed(42) left spotCenter/trainLons/polarPhase bit-identical). Standalone it would under-deliver anyway: latitudes stay frozen-shear-shared, and Max's handoff diagnosis records longitude-only motion doesn't read as different placement. Cite symbol anchors, not line numbers, in build docs.

D-SLOT DERIVATION (the increment's namesake): shellDepthFrac, internalHeat, dissipation stop being frozen constants and derive from the condition bundle per ATMOSPHERE-PLAN §(e) — per-seed shear profile => per-seed storm latitudes. This discharges atmo-3b AC-0's declared-frozen-constant debt; the derivation forms are pinned at BUILD-PLAN with a research slice if needed (slice-R pattern).

CANONICAL-N DEMOTED TO PRIOR (Max re-ruling 2026-07-15, supersedes the ratified rider B pin): polar-N becomes a regime-conditioned bias the seed varies around; vortex PRESENCE is gated per-seed by derived conditions. Saturn-like regimes stay hexagon-LIKELY, not hexagon-pinned; other regimes can morph N/shape/size/position or lack vortices entirely. Same seed still reproduces exactly.

PROVENANCE ROUTED OUT: no GUI provenance/badging work in this increment — that is planet-lod-lab-ux-2026-07-15 on L1 (avoids two branches reorganizing the same GUI). This increment keeps its planet-lod-lab.html footprint MINIMAL: the reseed wiring + any new D-slot sliders only.

GENERATIVE-NOT-SIMULATIVE HOLDS: still no uTime in storm terms; variety is place-once per seed. Render primitives (filamentation/wake/interior/chromophore GLSL) are consumed unchanged — this increment moves DERIVATION, not expression.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The New-planet button and the macro-seed GUI slider re-run the storm/polar writer: reseeding through EITHER path re-places storms and polar state, matching an independent writer re-call at the new seed (today both paths leave spotCenter/trainLons/polarPhase bit-identical).

verifyVia.input: In the running lab on :5178, click 'New planet' (and separately drag the macro-seed slider), capturing storm/polar state before and after.
verifyVia.observable: Post-reseed state (spotCenter/trainLons/polarPhase and companions) differs from pre-reseed AND bit-matches an independent in-page resolveStormE/resolveStormPlacement call at the new seed.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Storm latitudes derive per seed — 'the spots/storms appear in the same place every seed' is dead. Across a seed sweep at fixed regime, primary-storm latitudes take materially distinct values (no bit-shared latitude across all seeds), stay regime-plausible (within the anticyclonic shear band the derived profile produces), and reproduce exactly at the same seed.

verifyVia.input: Headless writer calls across a pinned seed sweep (>=12 seeds) per giant regime, twice per seed.
verifyVia.observable: Latitude sets are non-degenerate per the BUILD-PLAN-pinned variance floor; same-seed pairs are bit-identical; distributions stay within regime bounds.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Band layout varies per seed: 'much more variety in placement, direction of movement' — band/jet counts, edge positions, widths, and per-band drift direction derive from the seeded D-slot conditions, not a fixed belt template.

verifyVia.input: Headless E5/band profile generation across the same pinned seed sweep per regime.
verifyVia.observable: Jet-position/width/count sets differ materially across seeds (BUILD-PLAN-pinned floor); drift-direction assignments vary across seeds; same seed reproduces exactly.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Polar vortices 'change shape/size/position across seeds' and don't 'always appear': presence is gated per-seed by derived conditions; N varies around the regime-conditioned prior (Saturn-likes hexagon-likely, not pinned); size/shape/position vary per seed.

verifyVia.input: Headless polar resolution across the pinned seed sweep per regime.
verifyVia.observable: Presence flips across seeds at regime-appropriate rates (some seeds have no vortex where the prior allows); N/size/position distributions are non-degenerate; Saturn-like regime's modal N remains the hexagon prior; same seed reproduces exactly.
